name: tqdm/tqdm
checklist: The applicable category checkbox is ticked (exception-raising fix, visual output fix, documentation modification, new feature)
Any AI-assisted commit carries an author, Co-authored-by or Assisted-by trailer in the form `Provider Model <email>`
The issue tracker was searched for duplicates
Version numbers, operating system and environment are stated
The new test fails without the source change
notes: The pull request template requires AI-assisted commits to be marked with a trailer and gives `Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>` as its own example, so disclosure is mandatory rather than optional.
CONTRIBUTING.md has no separate AI policy and nothing in it forbids assisted work.
No changelog directory: releases are generated from the commit history, so no fragment file is expected.
tqdm.std must stay dependency-free; contrib submodules may use third-party libraries.
